title: Cancellation Schedule Rider: Notice Nights When a Guest Leaves a Stay in Progress
content:
# Rider — notice nights kept when a guest leaves a stay in progress

**Rule.** When a guest cancels a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category that is already in progress, the nights the cancellation keeps include notice nights, the nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date that come first. How many notice nights the cancellation keeps depends on the stay: a stay of 28 nights or more keeps the after-check-in notice nights of its cancellation policy; a shorter stay booked under a policy whose after-check-in refund percentage is 0 keeps no notice night; any other stay keeps 1 notice night. When fewer nights remain after the cancellation date, the notice nights are those that remain.

The length of the stay is its number of nights as recorded on the stay; the policy is the one recorded on the stay.

## Rider table

| Cancellation policy | After-check-in refund percentage | Notice nights kept, stay under 28 nights | After-check-in notice nights (kept by a stay of 28 nights or more) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible | 100.00% | 1 | 1 |
| Moderate | 50.00% | 1 | 1 |
| Limited | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Firm | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Strict | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Super Strict 30 Days | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Super Strict 60 Days | 0.00% | 0 | 0 |
| Long-Term | 100.00% | 1 | 30 |

## Threshold on both sides (hypothetical stays)

| Stay | Nights | Notice nights kept |
|---|---|---|
| Long-Term stay | 28 | 30 (the stay reaches 28 nights) |
| Flexible stay | 27 | 1 (shorter, refund percentage 100.00%, not 0) |
| Firm stay | 27 | 0 (shorter, refund percentage 0) |

## Fewer nights remaining (hypothetical)

A hypothetical 40-night Long-Term stay is cancelled on its 26th night. The nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date number 14, fewer than 30, so the notice nights are those 14.
